did: I rebuilt the public landing's "What I built and use every day" as a scripted show, as the owner asked: each project is an episode, each scene's words stream in from its walkthrough's chapter, and only then do that episode's two cubes turn to the faces the words just named, all CSS on one clock with no script. After the owner previewed it, I put the page in the repo's own six session themes behind the app's palette icon, with a picker that closes on an outside click, Escape or a pick, on a phone too; stood calm skeletons where the cubes will come, a clip's frame or a still's; made the mochi blink, sway and lean; and let a reader send it a hug, a heart rising from it on a press, with nothing counted or kept. The producers now cut each face from the rendered videos, and drafts I wrote for the extensions stay off Pages until the owner reads them. Every head had a fresh review, recorded on the PR; the worst they caught were a focus ring hidden by the round mask and a phone tap on a theme that picked nothing.

calls.title: How a reader sends the mochi a hug with no script
options: a press, on :active with transitions, replaying every time
a checkbox stack, each tap checking the next box, capped
a small script for a true double click and a count
calls.why: The owner chose no script and no count; CSS can't see a double click, so a press stands in, and transitions replay it on every tap with nothing to cap or keep (C1187).
calls.undo: Render the mochi without its button and drop the hug's CSS; the idle blink and sway stay.

calls.title: How the theme picker closes, with no script
options: a popover for the open state, its radios inside, each theme's row a label beside it
a details disclosure that stays open until its icon is pressed again
a small script that closes it
calls.why: The owner wanted it to close on an outside click and on a pick; the browser dismisses a popover itself, a click on a row beside it counts as outside, and focus inside it returns to the palette (C1184).
calls.undo: Go back to the details disclosure in themes.ts and the landing's CSS.

calls.title: Where the landing's colours come from
options: every session theme, resolved from @some-ui/styles at build, the device's by default
the device's light and dark brand themes only
calls.why: The owner asked for the repo's themes; resolving them at build keeps no palette of the page's own, and a test holds every text pairing at 4.5:1 (C1184).
calls.undo: Drop themes.ts and give the template a palette again.

left: The three Extensions scenes are drafts in show.ts, off Pages until the owner reads and agrees their words (set draft to false).
Snips Capture needs one dispatch after merge; until then the Android faces show their title cards.
The server's faces wait on paulgsc/server sending its Grafana panel stills through the mailbox (after #3423); Site Assets still fetches the old server clip until then.
The résumé and authorship pages keep their own templates, without the themes or the picker.
